Frequency once per 10 minutes

You bind a hostile spell into your armor. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with a hostile effect that targets one creature, you store the spell in your armor instead. The spell must use a spell slot and take 2 or fewer actions to cast. Your armor can store only one spell in this way; you can't use Active Defense Firewall while you already have a spell stored.

When a creature touches or damages you with an unarmed melee attack or non-reach melee weapon, you can Cast the Spell stored in your armor as a reaction, targeting the triggering creature. Only the creature that triggered the reaction is affected by the spell.

You can Dismiss Active Defense Firewall. If you do, you immediately restore the spell to its spell slot.
